description: This file implements functions and classes for managing, serializing, deserializing, and restoring a disk cache index in the Chromium project, including index file handling, CRC checks, and disk scanning.

classes.name: SimpleIndexPickle
classes.description: A subclass of base::Pickle with a method to validate the header.

classes.name: SimpleIndexFile::IndexMetadata
classes.description: Holds metadata about the index, including serialization/deserialization logic.

classes.name: SimpleIndexLoadResult
classes.description: Holds the result of loading an index, including entries and status flags.

methods.name: CalculatePickleCRC
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum of a pickle payload.

methods.name: WritePickleFile
methods.description: Writes a pickle to a file using provided file operations.

methods.name: ProcessEntryFile
methods.description: Processes a cache entry file during index restoration, updating entries set.

methods.name: SimpleIndexFile::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes index metadata and entries into a pickle.

methods.name: SimpleIndexFile::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes index data from a pickle buffer into index structures.

methods.name: SimpleIndexFile::SyncRestoreFromDisk
methods.description: Restores index entries by scanning the cache directory on disk.

methods.name: SimpleIndexFile::SyncLoadFromDisk
methods.description: Loads index data from disk into memory, validating size and CRC.

methods.name: SimpleIndexFile::SyncWriteToDisk
methods.description: Writes index data to disk atomically.

methods.name: SimpleIndexFile::LoadIndexEntries
methods.description: Asynchronously loads index entries, either from disk or by scanning.

methods.name: SimpleIndexFile::WriteToDisk
methods.description: Serializes and writes index data to disk.
